descricao_original: Eosinophils are granular leucocytes with heterochromatic, bilobed nuclei and bright eosinophilic granules that fill the cytoplasm. Like neutrophils, eosinophils function in tissues and readily exit the blood stream. Eosinophils play a role in allergic reactions and parasitic infections as well as phagocytosis. 1000x

marcadores.explicacao_original: The specific granules of eosinophils contain a number of enzymes and other proteins that moderate the effect of vasoactive agents in inflammation, effect the killing of helminthic parasites, and phagocytose antigen-antibody complexes.
